text.tspan: The pipeline begins with the Pre-training stage shown on the left.
Source domain inputs are provided to the network.
These inputs pass into the Source Encoder.
The resulting features are directed into the Classifier.
The Classifier outputs the predicted class label.
On the right, the framework proceeds to the Adversarial Adaptation stage.
Source inputs are routed into the Source Encoder.
The Source Encoder forwards its output directly to the Discriminator.
In parallel, target inputs are fed into the Target Encoder.
The Target Encoder also transmits its output to the Discriminator.
The Discriminator receives representations from both encoders.
Finally, the Discriminator outputs the domain label.
